texts.preamble: Chintan Praveenbhai Gohel & 2 vs State Of Gujarat & 4....Opponent(S) on 7 January, 2016 Bench: Jayant Patel, Vipul M. Pancholi C/Wppil/91/2015 Or In The High Court Of Gujarat At Ahmedabad Writ Petition (Pil) No. 91 of 2015 ========================================================== Chintan Praveenbhai Gohel & 2....Applicant(s) Versus State Of Gujarat & 4....Opponent(s) ========================================================== Appearance: Mr Ph Pathak, Advocate for the Applicant(s) No. 1 - 3 Mr Rc Pathak, Advocate for the Applicant(s) No. 1 - 3 Mr Dm Devnani, Agp for the Opponent(s) No. 1 Mr Ma Saiyad, Advocate for the Opponent(s) No. 4 - 5 Mr. Parth H Bhatt, Advocate for the Opponent(s) No. 2 - 5
texts.facts: The petitioners have approached to this Court for espousing the public cause contending inter-alia that Jersey cow milk (hereinafter referred to as 'A1 milk') contains certain harmful element to the human in comparison to normal milk of Indian cow (hereinafter referred to as 'A2 milk'). The prayers are made to issue appropriate writ, to direct respondent Nos. 1, 2 and 3 to take effective steps to rule out the sale and circulation of A1 milk and its product.
texts.arguments: The grievance on the part of the petitioner is that A1 milk and milk product should not be marketed and it is alternatively contended that even if they are to be marketed, the consumer should be made to know that A1 milk contains particular percentage of beta-casein and the milk is of Jersey cow as A1 milk so that the consumer may decide whether to go for A1 milk or A2 milk. 4. On behalf of the Union of India, affidavit-in- reply has been filed, wherein it has been contended that it is not scientifically proved that A1 milk is harmful to the human body. It is further contended that the report which has been relied upon by the petitioners in the petition is on the basis of the test conducted upon the animal and not the human body and there is no conclusive evidence available to show that A1 milk is harmful to the human body. On behalf of the Food Safety and Standard Authority of India, the appearance is filed by Mr. Saiyad but reply has not been filed. 5. The aforesaid prima facie goes to show that there HC-NIC Page 2 of 4 Created On Sat Jan 09 01:50:09 IST 2016 C/WPPIL/91/2015 ORDER is no scientifically established evidence available in the record of the present proceedings to show that A1 milk is susceptible to the health risk of a human body based on the contents of beta-casein. However, at the same time there is no sufficient material in the present proceedings for any scientific test undertaken upon the human body for the adverse effect of A1 milk or A2 milk, as the case may be. If the petitioners find that they have authenticated scientific material to show the risk factor in the consumption of A1 milk by the human beings, it would be for the petitioners to approach before the Central Advisory Committee constituted under Section 11 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act').
